### Caesars Entertainment Brings Hotel Savings, $50 Show Tickets and More to the “Vegas 5-Day Sale”


09/22/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 510 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Entertainment-Brings-Hotel-Savings-50-Show-Tickets-and-More-to-the-Vegas-5-Day-Sale-2026.pdf)


*Offers include up to 60% off hotel rooms and discounts on select shows and attractions* *across Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts*


*To book now or for more information, including a complete list of deals,* *guests can visit*[caesars.com/vegasoffers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fspecials&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fvegasoffers&index=1&md5=8a58d958d3d22485f1106ed7cac9b92c)


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Caesars Entertainment is joining the “Vegas 5-Day Sale” with up to 60% off hotel stays and a variety of entertainment and attraction offers across its eight resorts on the Las Vegas Strip. The offers are available to book now through Tuesday, Sept. 29, extending beyond the official “Vegas 5-Day Sale” window.


*****For high-res photos and b-roll*** ***of Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts, click***[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1Qmf1pq5aXmN4-3Emw2KKh2Rn1lcgQngL%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=13a23bbf0baf0ca1ad2bbed180b8cef5) ********


“A great Vegas trip is about making the most of everything the city has to offer,” said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President of Caesars Entertainment. “Whether that’s staying at an iconic resort, seeing a headliner or taking in panoramic views from the High Roller, these offers bring together some of Las Vegas’ most memorable experiences at an exceptional value.”


Hotel savings of up to 60%, entertainment deals and attraction offers are available to book now through 9 a.m. PT on Tuesday, Sept. 29.


- **Ready. Set. Vegas. – Save Up to 60%** Guests can save up to 60% on stays at Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts through March 31, 2027, when booked by Tuesday, Sept. 29.


- **Showstopping Entertainment and Attractions Deals** Additionally, Caesars Entertainment is featuring deals on tickets for various shows and attractions when purchased by Tuesday, Sept. 29.


- $50 tickets are available for select shows at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace and PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino, including **“Josh Groban: GEMS The Las Vegas Residency,” “Tim McGraw: Live in Vegas,” Thomas Rhett, “Empire of the Sun – Ask That God: Afterlife North American Tour,” “Yandel – SINFÓNICO Tour,” “An Evening with Jeff Foxworthy & Larry The Cable Guy,” Bailey Zimmerman, Koe Wetzel, “Ali Siddiq: The Custom Fit Tour”** and **“LETTERKENNY LIVE.”**


- $30 tickets are also available for **“Jeff Dunham: Artificial Intelligence”** at PH Live.
- Fans can purchase discounted tickets **** for shows across Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts, including headliners **Donny Osmond** and **Wayne Newton,** as well as **Mat Franco, Colin Cloud, Paranormal, Piff the Magic Dragon, Chippendales, X Country, X Burlesque** and **RuPaul’s Drag Race Live!**
- Those looking to experience amazing Strip views on the **High Roller Observation Wheel** at The LINQ Promenade can purchase tickets for up to 20% off. Guests can also enjoy up to 25% off tickets for the **Fly LINQ Zipline** at The LINQ Promenade and the **Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck** at Paris Las Vegas.
- Visitors can receive $5 off adult tickets to **REAL BODIES** at Horseshoe Las Vegas, an immersive exhibit exploring the human body.


Beyond the “Vegas 5-Day Sale,” additional hotel packages featuring daily breakfast or a daily $50 food and beverage credit are available for booking now through December 2027.


- **Daily Breakfast Included** Visitors staying at Caesars Palace, Paris Las Vegas or The Vanderpump Hotel can receive daily breakfast for up to two guests.


- **Caesars Palace** guests can redeem the daily breakfast at Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay.


- **Paris Las Vegas** guests can redeem the daily breakfast at Dominique Ansel Marché.


- Guests at **The Vanderpump Hotel** can redeem the daily breakfast at GIADA.


- **Daily $50 Food and Beverage Credit**


- For stays booked at **Flamingo Las Vegas** and **The LINQ Hotel** , guests will receive a daily $50 food and beverage credit redeemable at a wide selection of restaurants, bars and lounges across all eight resorts.


To book or for more information, including participating venues, blackout dates and exclusions, guests can visit[caesars.com/vegasoffers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fspecials&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fvegasoffers&index=3&md5=d2398539a8a2483c15ef3710edc8f969) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs)**


**What is Caesars Entertainment offering in the “Vegas 5-Day Sale”?** Caesars Entertainment is offering up to 60% off hotel stays and discounted show and attraction tickets across its Las Vegas resorts. Additional hotel packages featuring daily breakfast or food and beverage credits are also available beyond the “Vegas 5-Day Sale.”


**When is the “Vegas 5-Day Sale” available?** Caesars Entertainment’s “Vegas 5-Day Sale” offers are available now for an extended booking window through 9 a.m. PT on Tuesday, Sept. 29.


**When are the Daily Breakfast and Daily Food & Beverage Credit packages available?** These additional hotel packages feature daily food and beverage offers and are bookable now through December 2027.


**Which Caesars Entertainment resorts are participating?** Participating resorts include Caesars Palace (including Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace), Flamingo Las Vegas, Harrah’s Las Vegas, Horseshoe Las Vegas, The LINQ Hotel, Paris Las Vegas, Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino and The Vanderpump Hotel.


**How many hotel guests can receive the daily breakfast?** Up to two guests may receive the daily breakfast for eligible bookings.


**What does the daily breakfast include for guests staying at Caesars Palace?** Caesars Palace hotel guests can redeem the daily breakfast at Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay.


Each breakfast includes:


- A choice of coffee or juice
- A breakfast pastry
- A choice of entrée: Breakfast Americain, French Omelet, Croque Madame, Croque Monsieur, Eggs Benedict, French Toast or Yogurt Parfait


**When is breakfast served at Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay?** Breakfast is served daily from 8 to 11 a.m.


**What does the daily breakfast include for guests staying at Paris Las Vegas?** Paris Las Vegas hotel guests can redeem the daily breakfast at Dominique Ansel Marché.


Each breakfast includes:


- A choice of coffee or juice
- A breakfast pastry (including Cronut ® pastry or Dominique’s Kouign-Amann)
- A choice of entrée: Perfect Little Egg Sandwich, Sausage Egg & Cheese, Avocado Toast, Croque Monsieur or Sweet Crêpe


**When is breakfast served at Dominique Ansel Marché?** Breakfast is served daily from 7 to 11 a.m.


**What does the daily breakfast include for guests staying at The Vanderpump Hotel?** Guests at The Vanderpump Hotel can redeem the daily breakfast at GIADA.


Each breakfast includes:


- A choice of drip coffee, tea or orange juice
- A choice of entrée: American Breakfast, Caprese Frittata, Blueberry Pancakes, Polenta Waffle or Yogurt Parfait


**When is breakfast served at GIADA?** Breakfast is served daily from 8 to 11 a.m.


**What is included in the Daily $50 Food and Beverage Credit offer?** The offer is available to book now through December 2027 and includes a daily $50 food and beverage credit for stays at Flamingo Las Vegas and The LINQ Hotel. The daily credit is redeemable at a wide selection of restaurants, bars and lounges across Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts.


**When can discounted show tickets be purchased?** Discounted tickets for select shows across Caesars Entertainment’s Las Vegas resorts are available for purchase through Tuesday, Sept. 29. Guests can visit[caesars.com/vegasoffers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fspecials&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fvegasoffers&index=4&md5=b7023aa0d45c5439a7fa3179d5b8491a) for the complete list of participating shows.


**Are there any attraction tickets included in the promotion?** Yes. Guests can save up to 20% on High Roller Observation Wheel tickets and up to 25% on Fly LINQ Zipline and Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck tickets through Tuesday, Sept. 29. Visitors can also receive $5 off adult tickets to REAL BODIES at Horseshoe Las Vegas.


**Are there blackout dates or restrictions?** Offer availability, participating venues, blackout dates and exclusions vary by offer. Guests can visit[caesars.com/vegasoffers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fspecials&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fvegasoffers&index=5&md5=b87c2ab265ccba83f08bbc3273f99ce5) for complete details and terms.


**Where can guests book these offers?** Guests can book directly at[caesars.com/vegasoffers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fspecials&esheet=54608520&newsitemid=20260921684111&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fvegasoffers&index=6&md5=9e9f95ee2ddae6977636517e38518f8f) .
